name: chrome
description: Control Chrome by importing the plugin Browser Client into Anybox's general-purpose Node REPL.

shortDescription.en-US: Use Chrome through a persistent Node REPL.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 通过持久 Node REPL 使用 Chrome。

longDescription.en-US: A self-contained Chrome plugin whose Browser Client is imported by the agent into Anybox's general-purpose Node REPL on first use. The plugin starts its own Browser Host, which owns the Browser Contract, policy enforcement, local IPC gateway, Chrome bridge, extension, and platform-specific Rust Native Messaging Host.
longDescription.zh-CN: 一个自包含的 Chrome 插件，由 Agent 在首次使用时把 Browser Client 导入 Anybox 通用 Node REPL。插件会启动自己的 Browser Host，并在插件包内拥有 Browser Contract、策略校验、本地 IPC Gateway、Chrome 桥接、扩展和平台对应的 Rust Native Messaging Host。

permissions: Reads and controls Chrome tabs through the Anybox Chrome extension, including navigation, page inspection, screenshots, clicks, scrolling, typing, and form filling.
Uses a versioned Browser Contract and backend capabilities; the plugin-owned Browser Host revalidates every browser command before forwarding it.

Raw page JavaScript, selector-driven click/fill adapters, and Chrome DevTools Protocol commands are disabled at both the Browser Client and plugin-owned Browser Host boundaries; bounded selector waits remain available.
Registers and runs the plugin-bundled Native Messaging Host for the current user.
Requires the Anybox Chrome extension to be installed, enabled, and connected.
connectorRequirements.reason: The agent imports this plugin's Browser Client into Anybox's persistent general-purpose Node REPL; all Chrome-specific runtime behavior remains inside the plugin.

skillPreviews.name: Chrome
skillPreviews.description: Control the user's Chrome browser through a persistent Node REPL when tasks depend on existing tabs, signed-in sessions, extensions, visible page state, or UI interaction.
